compatibility.detail: The U.S. manual identifies robot QR2PPS and dock EWFD22LRR. Match both labels to your machine; different Qrevo docks or regional variants may use different parts.
Qrevo Master uses the DuoRoller Riser with two full-length rubber rollers. It is not the conventional single roller of Qrevo Pro or the DuoDivide brush system used by Qrevo Curv.

The robot washable filter is a Master/Slim/Saros Z70/Qrevo Curv 2 Flow-specific part family. A dock dust bag is a separate disposable part; a bag listing alone does not establish filter compatibility.
Roborock lists the Qrevo Master for the two-piece side-brush family and round Qrevo mop cloths. Replace the cloths only; the rotating mounts and drive parts are separate.

careTip: Let a rinsed washable filter dry for at least 24 hours before reinstalling it. Switch the robot off before servicing the brushes or mop components.

questions.question: How do I identify the U.S. Roborock Qrevo Master?
questions.answer: The U.S. manual lists robot model QR2PPS and dock model EWFD22LRR. Check both labels before choosing parts.

questions.question: Does the Qrevo Master use DuoDivide brushes?
questions.answer: No. The Qrevo Master uses two full-length rubber rollers in its DuoRoller Riser assembly. DuoDivide is a different split-bristle system used by other models such as Qrevo Curv.

questions.question: Can I use a Qrevo S or Qrevo Pro filter?
questions.answer: Do not assume so. Roborock has a separate filter listing for Qrevo Master, Qrevo Slim and Saros Z70; the linked filter listing says it is compatible only with the models it names.

questions.question: Are all the linked parts genuine Roborock?
questions.answer: The DuoRoller brush set, washable filter and side brushes are Roborock-branded. The mop cloths and dock bags are third-party products. DustMigo has not physically tested third-party fit or durability.
